name: @oak-kay/surface-kernel
description: Framework-neutral engines shared by the documentation site and the desktop application.
//: The '.' entry is conditional because this package has two kinds of consumer.
Bundlers take 'default' and read the TypeScript source directly, which is how
the desktop renderer bundle and the documentation site have always consumed
it. Node takes 'node' and reads ./dist/index.js, because Node cannot load a
'.ts' file: it strips types only when asked (--experimental-strip-types, as
this package's own test script does) and not by default until 22.18.0, which
is newer than the pinned toolchain. Before this entry existed, every file Node
executed directly that imported this package by name died on the first import
with ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION naming src/index.ts. That broke the desktop
build script, and separately the documentation-site build configuration.
./dist is generated and git-ignored. 'npm run build' in this package writes
it, and the desktop workspace's 'prebuild' script runs that before its own
build, so nothing consuming the 'node' condition sees a stale or absent file.
A consumer that reaches it without building gets ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND naming
dist/index.js, which says what to do; the old failure did not.
